name: Character counter
summary: An "n of max" line under a text field that gets louder near and past the limit.
description: Use maxlength for a hard limit the browser enforces, or data-v-max for a soft limit people can go over (and then fix). Screen readers hear it only on entering the last 10%, at the limit and when going over, not on every key.

classes.name: v-counter
classes.description: The counter line. Write it in the markup to place it yourself; otherwise the JS adds it at the end of the field.

states.description: Set by the JS: "near" (last 10%) and "full" in the warning colour, "over" in the danger colour.
A hard limit on the input or textarea. The counter reads it as max.

hooks.name: data-v-counter
hooks.description: Counts the characters in the field's input or textarea. Needs maxlength or data-v-max.

hooks.name: data-v-max
hooks.description: A soft limit, used when the control has no maxlength.

a11y: The counter is added to the control's aria-describedby, so it is read with the field.
Announcements are polite and only at the 90%, full and over thresholds, so typing is not interrupted.
Past the limit the colour changes and the text says so ("Over the limit by 4" is announced), never colour alone.

examples.title: Hard limit
examples.html: Grows as you type, where the browser supports it.

examples.title: Soft limit
examples.description: data-v-max lets people type past 60 and shows how far over they are.
